svg.title: CC-on-Bedrock deployment profiles
svg.desc: Governance uses a private EC2 dashboard and local Cognito/STS authentication. Optional DevEnv adds nginx Fargate routing and per-user EC2 with persistent EBS. Both paths share Bedrock usage, DynamoDB budgets and IAM enforcement. WAF and edge authentication apply to the DevEnv distribution.

text.tspan: Governance is the default. DevEnv adds private EC2 environments; both paths share usage, budgets and IAM controls.
Existing VPC | Private workloads (AZ detail omitted)
Native Claude Code OTEL → private collector → scrubbed S3 signals → Lambda rollup →
① Browser DevEnv access uses its own CloudFront distribution.
Origin SGs restrict internal load-balancer access; DevEnv also
② Local CLI and EC2 invoke Bedrock directly. Claude uses
application inference profiles; Codex Responses is attributed by user
③ Usage tracker writes DynamoDB; token streams and scheduled
budget checks attach IAM denies. Kiro licensing is outside token
